codeLaneFields: not applicable: doc_repo lane. No PRs, no merge SHAs, no CI conclusion strings. Nothing was built, merged or deployed.
missionPremise: The dispatch's premise was that county onboarding is the wrong unit of work and that Thrall, an incorporated Williamson city whose brief refused on four rails, proves it, because 'nobody has ever enumerated which places inside an onboarded county have no coverage' and 'working only from our own list is how Thrall stayed invisible'. The first half is upheld and the second half is CONTRADICTED at source. Sources: _dispatches/2026-09-13_coverage-sub_dispatch.md; operator observation of 202 ELECTRA ST, THRALL, TX 76578 on smartsite.cloud 2026-09-13; 90_operations/OPS-22_spine_architecture_map.md section 2.
completionPredicate: A stranger can evaluate this without the author: open _inbox/2026-09-13_subcounty_coverage_audit.md; every place with land in Bastrop 48021, Caldwell 48055, Hays 48209, McLennan 48309, Travis 48453 or Williamson 48491 that appears in _catalog/texas_roster_v1.json has a row naming whether a zoning layer is staged, whether it is wired in ZONING_LAYERS, whether a registered setback table covers it, how many of its parcels bind, refuse or polygon-miss, and what one real parcel returns on the deployed surface; the OPS-22 69/23 baseline is reproduced or contradicted with both figures shown; the ranked no-coverage list is ordered by parcel count; and the COULD NOT ESTABLISH section is non-empty. Thrall appears as a row (Williamson section, and rank 31 in the ranked list, 487 refused parcels). All predicates met for the incorporated-city class. NOT met for the CDP / unincorporated-community / postal-place class, which is why this close is partial.
scopeBasis: Boundaries and why, so a successor can tell a deliberate exclusion from an oversight. INCLUDED: the incorporated-city class, because _catalog/texas_roster_v1.json is the only roster in reach that carries a per-city zoning-layer probe record with a date and a probing lane. EXCLUDED and named, not overlooked: CDPs, unincorporated communities and postal-only places, because the only roster available holds record_type 'city' exclusively (1,223 records statewide) and enumerating them from parcel_record_cell.situsAddress would have produced a mailing-city list, which is not a jurisdiction list, and would have invited exactly the mis-reading this lane rejected at McGregor. EXCLUDED: any acquisition, wiring or build, per dispatch rule 4. EXCLUDED: landing_parcel_jurisdiction, not by choice but by credential; the substitute instrument is named in every row that uses it.
falsifier: Five falsifiers were pre-registered in CP1 BEFORE the checks ran. F1 (roster reproduces OPS-22's 69 by parent county) HELD. F2 (23 with a zoning source_url, split 3/3, 3/3, 5/11, 7/14, 3/18, 2/20) HELD, exactly. F3 (ZONING_LAYERS wires strictly fewer than 23) HELD, 17. F4 (Thrall absent from every roster we hold) FALSIFIED. F5 (the roster's zoning_layer.status agrees with source_url presence) FALSIFIED. The result that would have proven the central enumeration wrong was named in advance: if the Factory store's set of cities with parcels bound to a staged zoning layer had differed from the roster's set of cities carrying a zoning source_url, one of the two instruments would be wrong and neither could be trusted. The two sets, derived a month apart from different sources, are identical with zero members on either side of the difference.
contradicted: TWO planner-supplied premises were contradicted and both are reported loudly rather than quietly worked around. FIRST: the dispatch says working only from our own list is how Thrall stayed invisible. Thrall was never invisible. _catalog/texas_roster_v1.json holds Thrall at place_fips 72824, probed 2026-08-12T22:14:05Z by lane Z1-central-tx-reopen, with a positive determination of absence and a written basis. parcel_record_cell holds 487 Thrall parcels whose zoningJurisdictionKey cell is 'refused' with the reason 'no tx_zoning_district_staging base layer exists for Thrall yet -- a data-acquisition gap, not a join failure'. Every layer recorded the gap correctly and no layer ever rolled it up. The defect is a missing rollup and a missing gate, not a missing roster, and the fix is different. SECOND: the dispatch says nobody has ever enumerated which places inside an onboarded county have no coverage. The serving store enumerates it per parcel, by name, with counts: 73,321 parcels across 48 named places. The enumeration existed; it was never aggregated to anywhere a human reads. THIRD, not a contradiction of the dispatch but of my own first reading, recorded in CP2: a cross-tab appeared to show 4,170 parcels flagged incorporated while carrying a not-applicable cell whose reason says unincorporated. Pulling the actual reason strings showed the subpopulation carries a DIFFERENT and honest reason. The contradiction I was about to report does not exist and was not reported.

findings: The sub-county coverage enumeration already exists per parcel in the serving store and is aggregated nowhere. 73,321 parcels across 48 named places refuse with a reason naming the place. Nothing rolls it up, so county onboarding closes 48 places at a time.

McGregor, an incorporated McLennan city in the roster, appears in NO store vocabulary: zero bound, zero refused, zero polygon-miss. It is strictly worse than Thrall, which at least produced 487 named refusals. Two mechanisms, neither eliminated from this seat: the binder's city-boundary layer has no McGregor polygon so its parcels fall to not-applicable carrying the reason 'unincorporated parcel', which would be a false statement written into the record for an incorporated city; or its parcels are absent from the store. Settling it needs a tx_city_boundary enumeration for 48309.

The deployed surface contradicts the canonical record in BOTH directions while declaring readPath 'record'. 48309:161056 (Beverly Hills): record refuses zoningDistrict, surface serves district R-2 with facetCoverage.zoning true. 48021:103265 (Smithville): record holds SF-1, surface serves SF-1 and in the same payload sets facetCoverage.zoning false and declines the envelope as no-zoning-stamp with the disclosure 'No zoning district observed'. 20 of 33 bound-city probes show the second shape. Favoured mechanism: the zoning facet is composed from the bake (all 88 payloads carry bakedAt in July or August; the record cells were written 2026-09-02 to 2026-09-10) while facetCoverage and the envelope come from a different read, and recordRailStates is a decorative declaration. Competing mechanism not eliminated: production reads a different Factory database or branch.

The roster field cities[].zoning_layer.status is not a safe read. 12 of the 23 carry source_url set, verification verified-live, a positive features_staged count, and status NOT-FOUND-UNKNOWN-WHY, including Bastrop city (7,075 staged) and Taylor (8,145 staged). The status column was overwritten by the L20 factory1.5 fan at 2026-08-14T21:37:46Z and is not derived from the evidence in the same object. Read source_url and features_staged.

OPS-22 section 2's '69 cities' does not state its counting rule. It is cities by parent county. 72 cities have land in the six and 88 is the place-by-county pair count. All three are correct and they are not interchangeable.

ZONING_LAYERS entries are county-scoped while setback tables are city-keyed, so Austin's 411 Hays parcels and 13,924 Williamson parcels sit outside the registry entry that covers Austin, and San Marcos's 70 Caldwell parcels sit outside its. Elgin is the only city registered twice.

zoningJurisdictionKey kind not-applicable carries two populations (genuinely unincorporated, and inside-a-wired-city polygon miss) that no consumer can separate without a regex over prose. The reasons are honest; the kind is not discriminating.

setbackRules absent-verified carries two meanings (no table exists for this city, and this stamped code is not a district). Hays, which writes unaccounted instead, appears in neither list and would be scored as having no setback problem by any instrument counting absent-verified.

landing_parcel_jurisdiction was never read; parcel_record_ro cannot see it. The substitute instrument (parcel_record_cell zoningJurisdictionKey) was used throughout and the two have never been reconciled. If they disagree that is a free finding and nobody has looked.
tx_city_boundary and tx_zoning_district_staging were never read; both are outside this credential. OPS-22's 69 was reproduced from a different source, not confirmed at its own.
Whether production's record read points at the same Factory database this credential reads. Needs the serving service's secret binding read by field name off the deployed revision.

Whether any of the 48 refused places actually publishes a zoning layer we have not found. This audit measured OUR state, not the world's. The T6 probes recorded NOT-FOUND-UNKNOWN-WHY, which under the seven-value taxonomy explicitly re-enters the queue rather than asserting non-existence, and a month has passed.

LESSON: parcel_record.place_key is the PARCEL identity '<countyFips>:<propId>', never a place key. Reading it as a city binding is a silent wrong answer.

parcel_record_cell's pkey is (place_key, rail_key), so a place_key prefix range still walks all 65 rails per parcel: a single-county prefix scan on one rail timed out at 240 s, while the same aggregation over the WHOLE table using parcel_record_cell_rail_idx returned in 15 s. Filter by rail first and derive the county from substring(place_key,1,5).

A cell's `kind` is not the whole state. zoningJurisdictionKey not-applicable carries two populations and setbackRules absent-verified carries two meanings; both are distinguishable only from the reason or basis prose. Any instrument that groups by kind alone will merge classes that must not merge.

The smartsite.cloud facets endpoint answers anonymously (/api/pe-situs-search and /api/spine/property-atoms/<node>/facets), so a live-surface leg needs no credential; 88 probes at 4-way concurrency took 20.8 s.
DEAD-END: Grepping the LDT checkout with a plain recursive grep: node_modules pushes it past a 120 s timeout. Use `git grep -- '*.ts'` (tracked files only), and read content with `git show origin/main:<path>` so the read is of the authoritative record rather than a stale dirty tree.

FACTORY_DATABASE_URL_RO does not answer the parcel-to-place binding question directly: the role sees only four tables and landing_parcel_jurisdiction is not among them. Do not dispatch a lane that depends on that table against this credential.
GROUND-TRUTH: 2026-09-13: Factory store neondb holds 981,405 parcel_record rows, all six CTX counties, 611,116 incorporated.
2026-09-13: envelopeStatus and buildableAreaSqFt are `value` for ZERO parcels in all six counties.
2026-09-13: Hays 48209 setbackRules is unaccounted for all 54,835 incorporated parcels; the other five counties are written.
2026-09-13: 23 cities have parcels bound to a staged zoning layer; 17 are wired in ZONING_LAYERS; the same 17 have a registered setback table.
2026-09-13: all 88 smartsite.cloud facets payloads sampled carry bakedAt in 2026-07 (35) or 2026-08 (53); none in September, while the record cells behind them were written 2026-09-02 to 2026-09-10.
OPEN: The surface-versus-record divergence needs an owner. It is a serving-path defect, not a coverage defect, and it is the only finding here that can put a wrong zoning district in front of a customer.
A rollup of the store's own refusal reasons into something a human reads, plus a gate on it, is the direct fix for the premise this row was built on. The data is already there.
